Implement NORMALIZATION_SCHEMA_VERSION=1 with deterministic normalization statuses, validation severities, stable machine-readable issues, normalized fields, normalized expense proposal, reconciliation state and review state.

Treat the N5.2 ExtractionProposal as immutable input evidence. Preserve rawValue/extracted value, provider confidence, source and evidence; add normalized values and issues without rewriting extraction evidence.
Implement pure deterministic provider-independent logic with no network, Supabase, browser state, Date.now, randomness or environment-dependent decisions.

Implement exact decimal-string normalization/arithmetic for accounting values without JavaScript floating-point accounting. Include addition, subtraction, comparison and absolute-difference operations and document the exact 0.01 reconciliation tolerance.
Normalize only deterministic decimal representations; ambiguous representations must remain review-required rather than guessed.
Normalize currency without defaulting EUR. Explicit euro symbol may normalize to EUR; missing remains missing; unknown values produce a stable validation issue.
Normalize deterministic dates to YYYY-MM-DD, reject impossible calendar dates, and mark locale-ambiguous forms rather than silently assuming EU/US order.
Normalize invoice numbers conservatively while preserving prefixes, suffixes, leading zeroes, slashes and meaningful hyphens.

Normalize tax-id candidates separately from supplier identity. Implement deterministic Spanish NIF/NIE/CIF checksum/format validation while foreign/unknown identifiers remain candidates with UNKNOWN_FORMAT rather than becoming supplier matches.
Implement document-type-aware validation for INVOICE, RECEIPT, CREDIT_NOTE, OTHER and UNKNOWN without inventing document type.
Implement VAT-line validation and multi-VAT reconciliation. Support zero, common Spanish rates and other legitimate rates without hard-coding Spain-only rates as a universal allowlist.
Support negative monetary values and CREDIT_NOTE semantics.
Implement reconciliation states MATCH, MISMATCH, INSUFFICIENT_DATA and COMPLEX_ADJUSTMENT. Discounts/withholding must prevent application of an invalid simple net+tax=gross identity.
Keep extraction confidence separate from validation policy. A high-confidence field may still conflict with deterministic accounting checks.
Derive READY_FOR_REVIEW, NEEDS_ATTENTION or BLOCKED deterministically; never mark CONFIRMED.

Tests must cover decimal formats/ambiguity/negatives/large values/zero; dates including ISO, deterministic day-first, impossible and ambiguous values; currency; invoice numbers; valid and invalid NIF/NIE/CIF plus foreign unknown format; VAT single/multi lines; reconciliation/tolerance/mismatch/discount/withholding; credit-note negatives; low confidence; input immutability; repeated-input determinism.
Document purpose, invariants, decimal/date/tax-id/reconciliation policies, review states, known limitations and explicit N5.4/N5.5 handoff in docs/N5_3_NORMALIZATION_VALIDATION.md.
